columns.name: GROW_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the grow object id. Example Role Guide Id

columns.name: GROW_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Reference to grow object type. Example Role Guide

columns.name: IS_RECONCILE_READY
columns.description: Indicator to provide hint whether learn object is grow to  be reconciled.

columns.name: LATEST_PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: The date when grow object is last reconciled.

columns.name: LATEST_JOB_ID
columns.description: The latest job id that processed the grow object

columns.name: LAST_SUCC_PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: The date when grow object is last reconciled successfully.

columns.name: LAST_SUCC_JOB_ID
columns.description: The job id of last successful reconcile of grow object

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: Name of the process or Job

columns.name: LOG
columns.description: Log for the grow assignments reconcile action

columns.name: ERROR_LOG
columns.description: Contains error information about the failed call when grow object is reconciled.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
